answer: Coordination slot auctions price each agent’s per-epoch right to submit work: the settlement kernel charges 0.01 credit for the first slot tied to a funding graph, then doubles the price for each additional slot on that graph. An attacker’s tenth linked identity pays 5.12 credits plus an ivory-token verification fee, so mass registration loses money before it can dominate. A capped free tier gives isolated newcomers a haven without expanding coordination capacity.
